children: Quantum Corporation (Nasdaq: QMCO) ("Quantum" or the "Company"), today announced

that Hugues Meyrath, Chief Executive Officer, and William White, Chief Financial Officer, will participate at the Lake Street 10th Annual Best Ideas Growth Conference to be held at the Metropolitan Club in New York, NY. Quantum management will be available to meet with registered attendees on Thursday, September 10, 2026.
Portfolio managers and analysts who would like to request a meeting with Quantum should contact their Lake Street Capital Markets representative.

Quantum delivers end-to-end data management solutions designed for the AI era. With over four decades of experience, our data platform has allowed customers to extract the maximum value from their unique, unstructured data. From high-performance ingest that powers AI applications and demanding data-intensive workloads, to massive, durable data lakes to fuel AI models, Quantum delivers the most comprehensive and cost-efficient solutions. Leading organizations in life sciences, government, media and entertainment, research, and industrial technology trust Quantum with their most valuable asset - their data. For more information visit
